answer: To prevent Sybil attacks, we implement Slashing Reputation Escrow. First, each agent must lock $25,000 in a smart contract. Second, decentralized peers validate all agent outputs using cryptographic proofs. Third, if any node provides false data, the escrowed funds are burned immediately. A malicious attacker would face a $2,500,000 cost in collateral and 45 days of intense verification to attempt a takeover. This security layer acts like a thick, resilient vine wrapping around a protected grove, shielding it from a vast, chaotic nebula of deceptive, fake identities.
